name: hammercode
author: HammerCode contributors
description: A transparent, local-first coding agent for macOS.

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env HAMMERCODE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.package:mac: electron --version && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64
